decision.name: P0_5_ARCHIVE_TO_OUTPUT_CAUSAL_COHERENCE
decision.finding: New A integration gap distinct from P0 final three-file agreement and P1 archive append safety: runner.py:120-144 reads archive into history before publishing three outputs. An interleaving where A loads empty history, B appends one causally visible offline row and publishes, then A publishes its stale handoff can leave a valid archive row absent from final source_evidence even when all three JSON outputs share the same as_of_ms and agree with one another. No independent witness yet; source-derived predicted RED only.
decision.improvement: Test-only no-network same-clock gate at runner.load_observations (not storage.load_observations), so the gate occurs after archive snapshot read and before output build. A has no external rows, B reads one valid local fixture; B may overtake or wait behind correct serialization. Check archive-to-handoff causality, not just three output stamps.
decision.pytest_source:
import json
import threading

from part2.capital_flow import runner
from part2.capital_flow.contracts import FlowObservation


def test_archive_handoff_same_clock_causality(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    T = 1800000000000
    row = FlowObservation(
        family="etf", metric="net_flow_usd", asset="BTC", value=125.0,
        unit="USD", effective_at_ms=T, available_at_ms=T, observed_at_ms=T,
        source="offline_fixture", source_record_id="row-B",
    )
    fixture = tmp_path / "writer-b.jsonl"
    fixture.write_text(json.dumps(row.to_dict()) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    a_loaded, release_a, b_done = (threading.Event() for _ in range(3))
    original = runner.load_observations

    def gated_load(path, *args, **kwargs):
        rows = original(path, *args, **kwargs)
        if threading.current_thread().name == "writer-A":
            a_loaded.set()
            assert release_a.wait(20), "A release timeout"
        return rows

    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "load_observations", gated_load)
    results, errors = {}, []

    def run(label, sources):
        try:
            results[label] = runner.run_once(
                local_dir=tmp_path, external_jsonl=sources,
                network=False, as_of_ms=T,
            )
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors.append((label, repr(exc)))
        finally:
            if label == "B":
                b_done.set()

    a = threading.Thread(target=run, args=("A", ()), name="writer-A")
    b = threading.Thread(target=run, args=("B", (fixture,)), name="writer-B")
    a.start()
    overtook = False
    try:
        assert a_loaded.wait(20), "A did not load archive"
        b.start()
        overtook = b_done.wait(10)
    finally:
        release_a.set()
        a.join(20)
        if b.ident is not None:
            b.join(20)
    assert not a.is_alive() and not b.is_alive()
    assert not errors, errors
    assert set(results) == {"A", "B"}
    archive = original(tmp_path / "observations.jsonl")
    assert len(archive) == 1
    assert archive[0].source_record_id == "row-B"
    latest = json.loads((tmp_path / "latest.json").read_text())
    audit = json.loads((tmp_path / "audit_latest.json").read_text())
    handoff = json.loads((tmp_path / "anata_latest.json").read_text())
    assert {latest["as_of_ms"], audit["as_of_ms"], handoff["as_of_ms"]} == {T}
    assert any(
        entry["source"] == "offline_fixture" and entry["observation_count"] == 1
        for entry in handoff["source_evidence"]
    ), "Archive has row-B but final handoff omits its causally visible evidence"
    print("B_COMPLETED_BEFORE_A_RELEASE=", overtook)
decision.acceptance: Observed B_COMPLETED_BEFORE_A_RELEASE=true plus missing row in handoff is RED. GREEN requires non-skipped target/full tests and witnessed coherence; B_COMPLETED_BEFORE_A_RELEASE=false without independent lock witness is INCONCLUSIVE, not proof of concurrency safety. Retain exact SHA, overlay hash, stdout/stderr, exit codes. Preserve original P0/P1 and separate C quality gates.
